raw: {"analysis": "Response HQH correctly sequences the deployment and flag toggle: deploy the code first, then toggle the flag 5 minutes before the migration window to account for propagation, ensuring read-only is active exactly when needed. It also properly handles the flaky network check, dual approval, CI duration, and irreversible rollback constraint. Response NWG incorrectly toggles the flag before deployment and ties the toggle to the deployment window rather than the migration start, which would misalign the read-only period and could cause the flag to have no effect or start at the wrong time. NWG also unnecessarily blocks deployment until flag propagation, which is not required. Both cover health check and write blocking, but HQH's timing and sequencing are more accurate and actionable.", "verdict": "HQH"}
